newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser, Modelo seek to resolve dispute.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser, Modelo seek to resolve dispute.

text.p: Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc, and Grupo Modelo SA have taken steps to resolve a dispute over adjusting the price of a transaction in which Anheuser will take a majority stake in the Mexican company, Anheuser said Tuesday.
In June, Anheuser, the world's largest brewer, said it planned to raise its stake in Grupo Modelo, which makes Corona beer, to 50.2 percent from 37 percent.
To settle the dispute, the companies will follow the procedures outlined in their investment agreement. The companies said they expected the matter will be resolved in two to four months.
If agreement is not reached, the matter will be submitted to binding arbitration, they said.

"The current differences with the controlling shareholders involve technical aspects regarding the determining of the price of Anheuser-Busch's option shares," August Busch III, chairman, said in a statement. "They don't involve any fundamental business or policy issues. The two companies are working together very well."
